answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pigment of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
